description: Nearly functional, the controller is undergoing so mechanical revisioning
body: Doing some mechanical alignments with parts. It's currently all computer work but we are getting there.
Current revision with rough draft PCB board in place. looks like everything is aligning correctly.
This is viewing the fitment and stroke tolerances of the silicone membranes.
This image is viewing the alignment of mounting screw holes between shell halves and the PCB.
Added the supports behind the buttons to absorb the stress of flexing the PCB.
